serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
What’s wrong with this alley? Trash is sticking out from the dumpster even more than usual. Damn, there is even some laying on the ground.
If any social worker saw that, it would be a 500$ bill for everyone throwing out their stuff here.
Huh? There is something weird here sticking out from one of the bins.
Woah! That’s a bot part!
Usually I would be disgusted by something that was in the garbage, but this thing looks pristine!
Why the hell would someone throw out such a thing?
Legality is an issue, sure, but even I would be conflicted about throwing a part like that.
A-anyway, let’s get this and get the hell out of here.
